text:
I came upon this child

as I walked toward the fields:

I found him there asleep

among the heads of wheat…


Or perhaps it happened

as I crossed the vineyard:

reaching for a vine leaf,

I brushed against his cheek…


And that is why I fear,

when I fall asleep,

he may vanish like

the frost upon the vines…

translation.title: I Came Upon This Child…
translation.editorial_note: Reuses a reviewed translation of the identical source body.
